description: Enhance the admin panel with improved organization and team management capabilities. Create a dedicated team details page showing team information, global settings, members, and pending invites. Update the organization page to display usage metrics and global settings, and improve member listings to show roles and IDs with navigation to their respective teams.
functional_requirements: Create a new team details page that displays team information, global settings, team members, and pending invitations
Update the organization page to include organization usage statistics and global settings display
Enhance organization member listings to show each member's role and ID with clickable navigation to their associated teams
Ensure all new pages and components follow the existing admin panel design system and navigation patterns
